responsibility: Render language, privacy, data-source, excluded-item, awakening, migration, cache, feedback and consent-management settings using the app-wide Balanced Canvas visual profile and Apple-native task controls

inputs.storageAndCache: Live local storage and cache summary
inputs.migration: Live ADR-008/ADR-010 encrypted migration service state; transfer secret remains outside ViewModel persistence
inputs.runtimeStatus: Live pending operations, degradation and task state

outputs.visibleContent: Grouped settings sections with shared profile headers, status presentation and action hierarchy
outputs.interactionTargets: language, source permissions, exclusions, awakening, encrypted migration/local-backup restore, cache, feedback, revoke consent and system settings
outputs.accessibilityTree: System Form reading order with stable labels, values, hints and destructive-action semantics

fallbackConditions: Masonry is always forbidden for this Task surface
Long localized content expands naturally using Dynamic Type
